header.capture_method: set -a; . ~/.factory-dispatcher/env; set +a; venv/bin/python with sys.path += apps/factory-dispatcher; substrate.default_store(); GET only (httpx.request wrapped to refuse any non-GET); every population paged by offset at limit 200 until a short page (dev.task, dev.note per parent_id, arch.release, arch.change, arch.requirement_conformance, dev.release, arch.observation); links via GET /beads/{id}/links (unpaged route).
header.date_in_filename: The filename keeps the 2026-09-23 date the design (docs/plans/2026-09-23-design-r2612-steerable-and-legible.md, 'Fixtures the outer loop commits with the first specs (D7)') and the PC-* acceptance criteria name; the capture itself is dated by captured_at.

definitions.matched_by_pr_refs: changes whose evidence_pr_url (content.evidence[0]) appears in some done task's content.pr_refs -- what find_task_by_pr_url (change_apply.py:301-305) reads today
definitions.matched_by_pr_url: changes whose evidence_pr_url equals some done task's content.pr_refs entry OR content.pr_url OR one of its attachment notes' url -- B19's widened match
definitions.resolvable_by_*: matched AND the matched task carries an outgoing delivers edge (resolve_release_binding returns a target)
definitions.resolvable_by_pr_refs_over_every_dev_tas: cross-check: resolvable_by_pr_refs recomputed over every dev.task (find_task_by_pr_url scans all states); equal to resolvable_by_pr_refs means restricting done_tasks to done/archived loses nothing
definitions.existing_delivers_edges: changes carrying >=1 outgoing delivers link at capture
definitions.expected_new_delivers_edges: changes resolvable_by_pr_url whose resolved release is not already a delivers target -- what B19's first backfill run creates (PC-DEL-004 AC-2 reads this when the precondition is false; equals resolvable_by_pr_url - existing_delivers_edges when it is true)
definitions.newest_30_*: among the 30 newest changes by created_at, how many carry >=1 delivers / affects link
definitions.attachment urls: every attachment note on a done task; at capture every one's first line is 'Pull request opened for review: ...' (the B19 match)

header.verdicts: no dev.release beads exist at capture (0); every change's evidence[1] says so
header.no_pr_bodies: No PR bodies; PC-DEL-004 AC-3 uses synthetic bodies.
